She actually listens, whereas the rest think they're higher than what they are and feel they can speak down to you. They're dismissive and cut you off before you can even explain your situation and then they wonder why they find themselves having to ask you again what's wrong, if you don't like your job get a new one! And if you'd listen in the first instance it wouldn't take you twice the time to sort issues out.

I explained on the phone the day prior that I needed needles to administer my insulin and requested an emergency prescription because they hadn't bothered to update my repeat prescription online when the hospital had advised them to almost 2 weeks ago, I explained everything clearly on the phone what I needed and that it's the needles specifically for the insulin.

I'm a high risk pregnancy and I've had several hypos within the last 2 weeks and so it could genuinely be a matter of life or death if I don't have the appropriate prescription! I was assured that the FULL prescription would be available for me to collect, it wasn't! They didn't give me needles.

When trying to correct THEIR error, the receptionist had the nerve to tell me not to get frustrated even though I wasn't I was simply trying to explain myself but she wouldn't stop cutting me off to allow me to explain! Then told me there's nothing she can do and that I'll just have to try to get an appointment tomorrow.

It's not my fault they're incompetent and don't know the difference between lancets for testing blood sugar levels and the screw-in needles for insulin.

She said well the doctor can't do anything if it's not on the repeat prescription list. They were instructed in the beginning of March to update it by the hospital! Why is vital information not being processed when it's received from the hospital!? Stop acting like the patients are an inconvenience when your job is public facing.

Some of the doctors are incredibly rude and dismissive too. The majority of the staff are in dire need of retraining and personality transplants. I've seen the way the receptionists have spoken to vulnerable patients in the past too, absolute disgrace!

I'm only still there because my GP actually gets things done otherwise I'd have switched long
